faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://apply.jnujaipur.ac.in/; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.

faqs.question: How does admission to JNU Jaipur work?
faqs.answer: JNU Jaipur’s agriculture listing gives a 50% Science/Agriculture threshold and JET plus personal interview. The university also runs a wider scholarship-test process; do not assume that this replaces the agriculture-specific selection route. Confirm the current prospectus: Ask the admissions office for the applicable intake, subject requirements and selection rules before submitting an application. Request a written cost statement: Obtain tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation options and refund terms for the intended entry year.

faqs.question: How can I contact JNU Jaipur about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: 1800-102-1900. Published email: admissions@jnujaipur.ac.in. Official admissions: https://apply.jnujaipur.ac.in/

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. The [courses and fees table](/university/jaipur-national-university/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: Which school teaches agriculture at JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The university has a School of Agricultural Sciences and publishes a separate agriculture UG listing.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture?
faqs.answer: Both official agriculture pages specify four years.

faqs.question: Is the displayed ₹75,100 a verified annual fee?
faqs.answer: No. The readable page does not clearly establish its academic year and charging period, and says lab/library fees are separate. Request an itemised current schedule.

faqs.question: What selection method is listed?
faqs.answer: The agriculture programme pages list JET plus personal interview. Confirm current rules for the intended entry year.

faqs.question: Why is an older website FAQ about accreditation not followed?
faqs.answer: The page includes a stale pre-accreditation FAQ. The ICAR register records the agriculture term from 19 July 2022 to 18 July 2027; the discrepancy is logged for correction.

faqs.question: Which learning facilities are documented at JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Agriculture practical facilities identified in FAQ: The school FAQ identifies soil-science, entomology and crop-physiology laboratory work alongside agronomy fields, a horticulture orchard and farm machinery. This is a source list of learning settings, not a verified capacity or access schedule.

faqs.question: What establishment year is documented for JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Jaipur National University is recorded as established in 2007.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for JNU Jaipur?

faqs.question: How can applicants contact JNU Jaipur?

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: 4 years. The four-year degree covers agronomy, soils, plant breeding, crop protection and related disciplines. The published curriculum lists practical choices in seed production, mushroom cultivation, testing and beekeeping.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The official UG listing states 10+2 with minimum 50% in Science/Agriculture. The subject-combination text is incomplete on the page; obtain the current prospectus before assessing individual eligibility.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: A verified numerical fee is not available. The official page displays ₹75,100 tuition but does not establish a clear academic year and charging period. The amount is not converted into an annual or total-degree fee; lab/library costs are stated separately.

faqs.answer: Jaipur National University, Jaipur: • B.Sc.(Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 120), recorded term 2022-07-19 to 2027-07-18. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The published eighth-semester list includes seed production, mushroom cultivation and soil/plant/water/seed testing modules. The course page describes educational visits to agricultural research, extension and industry settings.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Agriculture practical facilities identified in FAQ: The school FAQ identifies soil-science, entomology and crop-physiology laboratory work alongside agronomy fields, a horticulture orchard and farm machinery. This is a source list of learning settings, not a verified capacity or access schedule.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The published agriculture outline includes hands-on subject modules and describes visits to research and agricultural institutions. This is curricular information, not a guarantee of a particular destination or visit for every student. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for JNU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The university has a scholarships and financial-assistance page. The agriculture course page simply refers to university norms; a dated agriculture-specific award schedule and its renewal conditions were not verified.
